title: [spec-gap][R-CCP12-018] python link/channel.py select_channel hash includes SFN, diverging from CCP-16 spec input and ccp16.json
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md. python/src/lichen/link/channel.py:145-152 hashes eui64 + epoch_LE + sfn_LE, but spec §3.1 defines Data = CONCAT(EUI64, Epoch_LE) only and §8.2 lists 'SFN inclusion' as a not-yet-implemented optional enhancement. Two same-named select_channel functions (channel_plan.py = CCP-16 vector-matching, link/channel.py = CCP-9 chain with SFN) yield different channels for the same peer/epoch when sfn≠0, so nodes using different modules cannot rendezvous by hash. Suggested: either remove sfn from the link-chain hash input or document the link-chain variant as a distinct algorithm in the appendix; make the channel_plan/link relationship explicit. Note rust select_channel_with_gnss uses eui64+epoch (no SFN), so python-link vs rust also disagree.
